description: 한국수력원자력(주)_방사성 폐기물 발생량 [nuclear facilities and waste management] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). 이 API는 한국수력원자력에서 운영 중인 원자력발전소의 본부별(고리원자력본부, 한빛원자력본부, 월성원자력본부, 한울원자력본부, 새울원자력본부) 중저준위 방사성폐기물 현황 자료를 XML. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수력원자력(주). Its tags are 방사능, 폐기물, 원자력, 방사성폐기물 발생량, 중저준위 방사성폐기물 현황. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
